run_adsorption_singlepoint: run singlepoint energy and force calculations on OC20 adsorption systems using an ASE calculator
calculate_adsorption_energies: calculate adsorption energies by comparing ML predicted energies against DFT reference slab and gas phase energies
evaluate_total_energy: evaluate total energy S2EF metrics for adsorption systems using the AdsorptionSinglePointRunner with evaluate_total_energy flag
write_results_json: write adsorption singlepoint calculation results to a compressed JSON file in the specified results directory
run_parallel_jobs: run parallel adsorption singlepoint calculations by splitting input data across multiple jobs using job_num and num_jobs
